solved_invariants: Persisted a source-hashed first-party pricing, concession, and dog-charge probe with a 12-month conditional maximum-special scenario while preserving quote uncertainty.
body.summary: Observed The Milo’s active first-party promotion: up to eight weeks free, waived application/admin fees, and look-and-lease condition through Aug. 31. Normalized A1’s conditional 12-month economics to $825 rent-only and $875 with one dog; move-in cash is $150 without a pet or $650 with one dog. The source does not bind a unit, move date, or term and conflicts with stale unit dates, so reconciliation—not averaging—was recorded.
